FAQs

Clearbot Fetch Skimmer – common questions

Find answers about Clearbot Fetch Skimmer specifications, operating applications and deployment planning.

What is Clearbot Fetch Skimmer designed for?

Clearbot Fetch Skimmer is a compact unmanned electric boat designed for floating waste collection and waterway surveys in hard-to-reach areas, including ports and marinas.

What types of surveys can Clearbot Fetch Skimmer support?

The published product information lists bathymetric, draft and environmental surveys. Sensor selection and final survey configuration should be confirmed for each project.

How long can Clearbot Fetch Skimmer operate on a charge?

The published battery life is 2 hours. Actual operating time depends on site conditions, operating mode, payload and configuration.

Does Clearbot Fetch Skimmer support solar charging?

Yes. The published charging options include battery swapping and solar charging.

What are the speed and range?

The published specifications list an average speed of 2 knots and a range of 5 km.

What is the payload capacity?

The published product page lists a payload capacity of 15–50 kg. Confirm the suitable payload configuration with our technical team.

Can it operate in confined or shallow water?

Clearbot Fetch Skimmer is described as compact and agile for confined and shallow water areas. Site suitability should be assessed against local depth, access and operating conditions.

How can we arrange a technical demo?

Use the Request a Technical Demo or Book a Technical Demo button to share your site details and operating requirements with the Clearbot team.
